items.item_text: Valid and Current Certified Nursing Assistant: CA certification upon hire or
Valid and Current Certified Clinical Medical Assistant certification upon hire or
Valid and Current Certified Medical Assistant NHA certification upon hire or
Valid and Current National Certified Medical Assistant NCCT certification upon hire or
Valid and Current National Registered/Certified Medical Assistant NAHP certification upon hire or
Valid and Current Registered Medical Assistant AMT certification upon hire or
Valid and Current Registered Medical Assistant certification upon hire or
Valid and Current Cert Med Asst - MMCI certification upon hire and
Valid and Current Basic Life Support - CPR certification through the American Heart Association upon hire
Current and valid Dysrhythmia certification (within 90 days of hire)
High School Diploma, GED, or two (2) years equivalent work experience
Previous experience as a CNA, Monitor Tech and/or Unit Secretary
Provide compassionate support with Activities of Daily Living (ADLs), feeding, hygiene, infant care, and ambulation, while monitoring vital signs and reporting changes to the nursing team
Assist with medical tasks such as EKG performance, simple dressing changes, foley care, and newborn screening, while ensuring accurate intake/output and telemetry monitoring documentation
Act as the primary unit receptionist by managing physician orders, maintaining patient charts, processing admissions/discharges, and ensuring all unit documentation is complete and compliant
Maintain continuous patient observation—including 1:1 sitter services and cardiac rhythm monitoring—to promptly identify, document, and escalate rhythm changes or safety concerns
Ensure a safe, clean, and organized clinical environment by managing inventory, stocking supplies, maintaining equipment, and facilitating communication between visitors, staff, and medical providers
Must be able to assist with meeting needs of all ages of patients
Ability to demonstrate respect for people, courteous behavior to fellow employees, patients, their relatives, visitors and to the Medical staff, and follow the core values of the organization
Ability to accept supervision and guidelines and work cooperatively with others
Ability to follow regulations of the Hospital pertaining to job performance, behavior, dress code and patient care
Ability to be flexible in meeting the needs of varying situations
Ability to ensure that patients' rights are respected
Must have the ability to read, write and speak English
